description: This file defines the OrderType entity class used in the OpenMRS medical record system. It models different classifications for orders such as Serology or Radiology test orders, including metadata, relationships, and utility methods.

classes.name: OrderType
classes.description: Entity class representing different types of orders within the system, including relationships to concept classes and potential parent order types, with utility methods for class loading and concept management.

methods.name: getOrderTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this OrderType.

methods.name: setOrderTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this OrderType.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the base method to get the ID, returning the orderTypeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set the ID, setting the orderTypeId.

methods.name: getJavaClassName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified Java class name associated with this OrderType.

methods.name: setJavaClassName
methods.description: Sets the fully qualified Java class name.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent OrderType, establishing hierarchy.

methods.name: getConceptClasses
methods.description: Returns the collection of ConceptClass instances associated with this OrderType.

methods.name: setConceptClasses
methods.description: Sets the collection of ConceptClass instances.

methods.name: getJavaClass
methods.description: Attempts to load and return the Java Class object for the class name associated with this OrderType.

methods.name: addConceptClass
methods.description: Adds a ConceptClass to the set of concept classes.
